overview_description.description: Baalbaki Chemical Industries manufactures and distributes polyester polyols, polyurethane systems, polyurethane auxiliaries, specialty adhesives, and coatings, as well as prepolymers. Baalbaki Chemical Industries offers polyesters, bulk delivery options, and a full range of polyurethane sstems for applications such as insulation, footwear, automotive, seating, and adhesives.

about_short_description.short_description: Baalbaki Chemical Industries produces polyester polyols and polyurethane systems.

product.name: Polyester Polyols (Purol®, Basis®)
product.description: Polyester polyols used as raw materials in polyurethane production, serving as key components in various polyurethane systems.

product.name: Polyurethane Systems (Polyrex Rigid®, Polyrex Footwear®)
product.description: Pre-formulated polyurethane systems designed for specific applications like rigid foams and footwear components.

product.name: Polyurethane Auxiliaries (Aminorex®, Silorex®, Matrix®)
product.description: Additives and auxiliary chemicals that modify and enhance polyurethane formulations during production.

identifier.value: Specialty Adhesives (Ecolad®, NP Adhesive®, PU Adhesive®)

product.name: Specialty Adhesives (Ecolad®, NP Adhesive®, PU Adhesive®)
product.description: Adhesive products based on polyurethane chemistry for bonding applications in multiple industries.

product.name: Prepolymers & Coatings (Isorex RF®, PUC®)
product.description: Prepolymer products and coating materials used in polyurethane applications for surface protection and finishing.
